description: PostgreSQL 18 enum creation, ordering, casts, arrays, indexes, catalogs, ALTER lifecycle, dependencies, and cascade
cleanup_sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS type_matrix_enum_rows CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_priority CASCADE;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS type_matrix_task_priority CASCADE;
sql: CREATE TYPE type_matrix_priority AS ENUM ('medium', 'low', 'high');
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_enum_rows (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, status type_matrix_priority NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium', history type_matrix_priority[]);
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_enum_status_idx ON type_matrix_enum_rows (status);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_enum_rows (id, status, history) VALUES ('high', 'high', '{medium,high}'), ('medium', 'medium', '{medium}'), ('low', 'low', '[0:1]={low,NULL}'), ('defaulted', DEFAULT, '{}');
SELECT id, status, array_dims(history), history, pg_typeof(status), pg_typeof(history) FROM type_matrix_enum_rows ORDER BY id;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_enum_rows ORDER BY status, id;
SELECT status, count(*) AS count FROM type_matrix_enum_rows GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

SELECT t.typtype, t.typcategory, t.typinput, t.typoutput, t.typreceive, t.typsend, a.typcategory AS array_category, a.typelem = t.oid AS array_element_matches FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_type a ON a.oid = t.typarray WHERE t.typname = 'type_matrix_priority';
SELECT enumlabel, enumsortorder FROM pg_enum WHERE enumtypid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'type_matrix_priority') ORDER BY enumsortorder;
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_priority ADD VALUE 'urgent' BEFORE 'high';
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_priority ADD VALUE 'deferred' AFTER 'low';
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_priority ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'deferred';
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_priority RENAME VALUE 'low' TO 'normal';
INSERT INTO type_matrix_enum_rows VALUES ('urgent', 'urgent', '{normal,deferred,urgent}');
SELECT id, status, history FROM type_matrix_enum_rows ORDER BY status, id;
SELECT 'normal'::type_matrix_priority < 'urgent'::type_matrix_priority AS ordered, 'urgent'::type_matrix_priority > 'deferred'::type_matrix_priority AS after_ordered;
SELECT 'missing'::type_matrix_priority;
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_priority ADD VALUE 'other' BEFORE 'missing';
ALTER TYPE type_matrix_priority RENAME TO type_matrix_task_priority;
SELECT format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = 'type_matrix_enum_rows'::regclass AND a.attname = 'status';
SELECT pg_typeof(status), status FROM type_matrix_enum_rows WHERE id = 'low';
DROP TYPE type_matrix_task_priority;
DROP TYPE type_matrix_task_priority CASCADE;
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'type_matrix_enum_rows' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_type WHERE typname IN ('type_matrix_priority', 'type_matrix_task_priority');
